proposal: Design CW flow about 38,700 m3/h (rise 6.8 K in WIN-NG-100), about 21,000 tubes; EPC re-rates the CW pumps.
question: With the constant CW flow of the heat balance (10,197 kg/s, 36,113 m3/h) the condenser rise is 7.20 K in MIN-NG-100 and 7.28 K in WIN-NG-100 against the EIA limit of 7 K (DP-CASE-0015; steady state, TQ-041). The EPC CW pumps deliver 38,000 m3/h (DEC-EPCE-0002), which would give about 6.9 K but a tube velocity of 2.21 m/s (ER-07.07: 1.8 - 2.2 m/s). Please (a) set the condenser design CW flow so that the rise is at most 6.8 K in every steady-state case, with the tube count adjusted to keep 1.8 - 2.2 m/s, and (b) re-issue the heat balance cases and DS-105.
subject: Condenser CW temperature rise above the EIA limit in the cold cases
